title: Riglane Pre-Step Output Snapshot
description: Schema for snapshot files at <runtime_dir>/data/.snapshots/<step>.json. Created by step_begin; read by output validator at step completion to enforce write-proof. The snapshot captures fingerprints (mtime + sha256 + size) of all output files BEFORE the subagent runs.

step.description: Step name this snapshot belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the snapshot was captured. Set on first creation; preserved across step retries (idempotent).

global.description: Map of output path templates (as declared in workflow.yaml) to their write_proof mode and per-resolved-path baseline fingerprints. For non-parallel steps, this contains all outputs.

branches.description: Per-branch snapshots for parallel steps. Keys are branch indices (string-encoded integers). Each branch records its branch_dir and its own outputs map. Empty object {} for non-parallel steps.

outputSnapshot.description: Per-output snapshot: the resolved write_proof mode and baseline fingerprints for every file currently matched by the path template.

write_proof.description: Effective write_proof mode after defaulting (explicit paths default to 'required'; glob paths default to 'all_members_fresh'). Outputs with write_proof: 'off' are not snapshotted.

baseline.description: Map of resolved file path -> fingerprint dict. Captures the state of each file at snapshot time.

fileFingerprint.description: File fingerprint at snapshot time. exists=false means the path resolved to nothing (file was absent). When exists=true, mtime/sha256/size MUST be populated unless the file was unreadable (in which case sha256 MAY be null).

mtime.description: POSIX mtime (float seconds since epoch). Null if file did not exist at snapshot.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of file contents. Null if file was absent or unreadable.
